comments.author: Slight-Living-8098
comments.body:
Yeah, you make a turn around sheet and feed it into something like Pixel3d or Trellis 2. ComfyUI has workflows and examples in the documentation for this. You can find the workflow templates under the template section in ComfyUI. There is also a model for rigging them called SkinTokens.

https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/3d/pixal3d

comments.author: Putrid_Clue_2127
comments.body: If you're open to a monthly subscription that's pretty cheap, I'd try Tripo. It's what I use. A set up prompts with Claude for what I want my game art asset to look like. Then I have Claude write the actual prompts for a 3/4 image and then if that image is what I want, I have Claude do prompts for front, back, left, and right. Separately. I have Claude do the prompts because it's good at adding verbiage to help keep the images from shifting. I run all prompts through ChatGPT. Then I upload the 4 views into Tripo and export at the highest quality. Then if I need a lower quality asset, I'll have Claude retopo the model carefully to get the triangle count lower without affecting textures or quality much.
